name: rv-tools
description: Agent Skills for RV, OpenRV and Autodesk RV / ShotGrid RV: labelled flipbook review and A/B compare, plus the command-line tools rvio (convert and transcode, slates, burn-ins, LUTs), rvls (list sequences, find missing frames, read headers) and rvpkg (install and manage RV packages), with baseline vs candidate comparison for renders, UI and web screenshots, .rv sessions and review notes, where reviewers can draw on frames in RV and Claude reads the sketches back. Desktop only: needs RV or OpenRV installed; does not work on claude.ai web or mobile. Free and MIT-licensed; if it saves you time: buymeacoffee.com/trespassvr

rv_bin.title: RV bin folder (optional)
rv_bin.description: Folder that holds rv and rvpush (and rvio, rvls, rvpkg): <install>/bin, or RV.app/Contents/MacOS on macOS. Leave it empty and the skills look in ~/.config/tvr-skills-rv/config.json, on PATH and in the usual install folders.
